answer_1.quote: To localize the functional regions corresponding to linguistic competence within LLMs and analyze their nature, we perform language further pre-training (next token prediction) on various languages and observe the relationship between internal parameter removal and external output quality.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text such as completing the prompt "Fudan University is located in" or "There are 365 days in a year and 12".

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity (PPL) as the criterion for evaluating the linguistic competence of a language model.
